Knowledge 2026 · Las Vegas · May 5–8

Welcome to
Agentic Business

The theme of K26 marks a generational shift — from AI that assists to AI that executes. ServiceNow announced the platform, the governance layer, and the autonomous workforce that makes it real.

"Knowledge 2026 is where the world comes to witness the next frontier of innovation: the Autonomous Platform where AI thinks and workflows act."
— Bill McDermott, Chairman & CEO, ServiceNow
Bill's opening — three points
The inflection point
We are at the moment where AI moves from assistant to autonomous workforce — executing work end to end across the enterprise.
The AI blind spot
Only 19% of enterprises are getting real value from AI. The average enterprise runs hundreds of disconnected apps — the Patchwork Enterprise.
From AI chaos to control
Companies that break out of the Patchwork Enterprise — on a unified platform with governance built in — see 2.5x better outcomes from agentic AI.

What's new from the keynote  View all announcements ↗
ServiceNow turns AI chaos into control
The AI Control Tower for Business Reinvention — one platform bringing together data, AI, workflows, and security to govern every agent, model, and workflow across the enterprise.
ServiceNow Otto — unified AI experience
One AI experience across the entire platform. You start it, Otto finishes it — role-personalised, action-oriented, combining Now Assist and Moveworks into a single front door.
Action Fabric — open to every AI agent
ServiceNow's full system of action is now open to any AI agent in the enterprise via a generally available MCP Server. Agents built on Claude, Copilot, or any stack can trigger governed ServiceNow workflows.
Build Agent — inside every major AI coding tool
Build anywhere, deploy on ServiceNow. Compatible with GitHub, Cursor, Codex, and any agent-first dev tool. Governance and security built in from the start — not bolted on.
Autonomous Workforce — every business function
AI specialists that execute specific roles end to end — expanding from the L1 IT Service Desk into CRM, HR, Employee Experience, Security, and beyond.
Autonomous Security & Risk — Armis & Veza
Govern every AI agent, identity, and connected asset. Armis closes the asset gap across 7B devices. Veza closes the permissions gap with 120B+ fine-grained permissions mapped.
AI Control Tower expansion
Now covers the full AI lifecycle — every agent, model, dataset, asset, and identity, across every cloud and enterprise system. Includes AI Agent Advisor and Intelligent Approvals.
Autonomous HR — AI that elevates every role
HR AI Specialists handle inquiries, onboarding, and case resolution end to end. HR resolves over 70% of inquiries automatically — freeing people for strategic work.
